as_told.title: Ingo Swann remote views the moon and is forced off by aliens

plain: Ingo Swann was a man known for "remote viewing", the idea that a person can see distant places using only the mind. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, and his guest, a researcher with a doctorate named Jeffrey Mishlove, both say Swann claimed he used it to travel to the Moon, where he believed aliens were present and forced him away. Mishlove places this in the 1970s. If true, it would mean someone is already on the Moon, and does not want visitors.
